subject.name: Daniel Lurie
subject.dataPolicy: Uses balanced source collection plus public San Francisco datasets only. No approval ratings and no fabricated metric, status, or progress values.

workflow.name: Pull sources
workflow.description: Scheduled job gathers official mayoral releases, local reporting, broad web/news results, and public metric feeds.

workflow.name: AI extraction
workflow.description: Sources are summarized into announcements, promises, claims, topics, and evidence-backed next actions.

workflow.name: Human review
workflow.description: Low-confidence AI interpretations are flagged before they affect status labels or scorecards.

workflow.name: Visualize
workflow.description: Dashboard converts structured records into topic charts, progress bars, timeline items, and metric deltas.

sources.title: News from the Office of the Mayor
sources.summary: Official mayoral news page configured as a primary source for Daniel Lurie announcements.

sources.title: Homelessness and behavioral health response announcement
sources.summary: Coverage of Lurie's plan to overhaul homelessness, behavioral health, and addiction response.

sources.title: Emergency powers for fentanyl crisis response
sources.summary: Board action gave the mayor additional flexibility to speed up fentanyl crisis response.

sources.title: Union Square programming through summer 2027
sources.summary: Downtown activation and programming effort tied to tourism, foot traffic, and economic recovery.

sources.title: Five-year update to San Francisco Climate Action Plan
sources.summary: Climate Action Plan update framed around emissions, household costs, and city resilience.

promises.text: Create an emergency shelter plan intended to end unsheltered homelessness in six months.
promises.statusNote: Awaiting official homelessness, shelter-capacity, placement, and encampment-resolution evidence before assigning progress or delivery status.

promises.text: Use emergency authority to accelerate city response to open-air drug markets and fentanyl-related street conditions.
promises.statusNote: Awaiting verified public safety, overdose-response, treatment-linkage, and budget/action evidence before assigning progress or delivery status.

promises.text: Keep Union Square activations running through summer 2027 to support downtown recovery.
promises.statusNote: Awaiting verified programming calendar, downtown foot-traffic, vacancy, sales-tax, and attendance data before assigning progress or delivery status.

promises.text: Publish and begin implementing an updated city Climate Action Plan.
promises.statusNote: Awaiting implementation metrics such as emissions inventory, building upgrades, energy-burden data, and funded actions before assigning progress or delivery status.

claims.claim: Downtown activations can support San Francisco's economic recovery by bringing more people to the core.
claims.evidencePlan: Compare Union Square foot traffic, hotel occupancy, retail vacancy, sales tax receipts, and event attendance before/after programming dates.

claims.claim: The updated Climate Action Plan can lower household costs while reducing emissions.
claims.evidencePlan: Track utility costs, retrofit adoption, emissions inventory, and household energy-burden datasets.

metrics.label: SF311 homelessness-related service requests
metrics.source: Public SF Data / DataSF Case Data from San Francisco 311 (SF311)
metrics.methodology: Monthly count of SF311 records matching homelessness or encampment terms. Values are populated only from the public DataSF API.

metrics.label: SFPD reported incident count
metrics.source: Public SF Data / DataSF Police Department Incident Reports: 2018 to Present
metrics.methodology: Monthly count of reported SFPD incidents from the public DataSF API. This is an activity/outcome indicator, not proof of causation.

metrics.label: Building permit filings
metrics.source: Public SF Data / DataSF Building Permits
metrics.methodology: Monthly count of building permit records from the public DataSF API. Used as a housing/economic activity indicator.

topics.label: Homelessness
topics.insight: Uses public SF311 homelessness-related service request data once refreshed; status remains unclear until reviewed.

topics.label: Public Safety
topics.insight: Uses public SFPD incident data once refreshed; impact should not be inferred without review.

topics.label: Downtown Economy
topics.insight: Needs a public SF dataset that directly measures downtown recovery; building permits can only serve as a broad activity signal.

topics.label: Housing
topics.insight: Uses public building permit data once refreshed.

topics.label: Climate
topics.insight: Needs a public SF emissions or implementation dataset before delivery judgments are shown.

timeline.title: Daniel Lurie mayoral term begins
timeline.impact: Tracker baseline date for promises, announcements, public SF metrics, and review tasks.

timeline.title: Homelessness and behavioral health overhaul covered
timeline.impact: Created an early promise requiring shelter capacity, outreach placement, and encampment metric validation.

timeline.title: Emergency authority for fentanyl response
timeline.impact: Moved public-safety response promise into implementation tracking.

timeline.title: Union Square programming extended
timeline.impact: Added a measurable downtown recovery promise with foot-traffic and vacancy indicators.

timeline.title: Climate Action Plan update released
timeline.impact: Plan publication is observable; implementation still needs emissions and cost metrics.

reviewQueue.title: Verify six-month unsheltered homelessness deadline
reviewQueue.reason: Status remains unclear until official counts, shelter capacity, and placements are reviewed before public scoring.

reviewQueue.title: Verify Public SF dataset mappings
reviewQueue.reason: Confirm the SF311, SFPD incident, and building permit datasets are the right public SF indicators for the first MVP topics.

reviewQueue.title: Add Anthropic API key in Vercel and GitHub
reviewQueue.reason: AI enrichment now expects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; without it ingestion still pulls sources but will not produce AI-structured updates.

reviewQueue.title: Connect Vercel project
reviewQueue.reason: Vercel configuration is in the repo; the project still needs to be imported and environment variables added in Vercel.

reviewQueue.title: Use JSON-based human review
reviewQueue.reason: For MVP speed, review decisions will be made by editing public/data/daniel-lurie-tracker.json and running validation before commit.

reviewQueue.title: Keep approval ratings out of the MVP
reviewQueue.reason: Approval ratings are intentionally removed; the MVP focuses on announcements, promises, claims, public SF metrics, timeline, and review tasks.

reviewQueue.title: Use Public SF datasets for metrics
reviewQueue.reason: Metrics should be populated only from public SF/DataSF datasets or official San Francisco public sources.

reviewQueue.title: Run first deployed Public SF refresh
reviewQueue.reason: Vercel and Anthropic are configured; manually run the GitHub ingestion workflow once so Public SF datasets populate metric observations from the internet.
